text: FEE016's functional requirements were reviewed from a marketing perspective.
UI MEO015 will explore adding the company logo to the handset design.
Teletext will not be used; the remote will be for TV only (no combined TV/video control).
RSI risk persists; moving to a smaller screen may not mitigate RSI, and the discussion may be postponed to a future meeting.
Budget constraints limit design options with misalignment between budget and the desired look and ongoing cost pressure.
Marketing data are not yet available; more information is needed to inform design and market validation.
